notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing: City Initiated Short-Term Rentals Text Amendment Request
notices.agenda_text:
Posted on May 28, 2026, on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: City Initiated Short-Term Rentals Text Amendment Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the City Council to consider the above listed request. The purpose of the request is to amend the text of portions of Draper City Municipal Code (DCMC) Titles 6 and 9 to require short-term rentals be licensed and permitted and to add associated standards.

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on June 9, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Todd Taylor at (801) 576-6510 or todd.taylor@draperutah.gov. 

Dated this 28th Day of May, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: City Initiated Draper-Highland Boundary Adjustment #2 Land Use and Zoning Map Amendment Requests

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the City Council to consider the above listed requests. The property is located at approximately 16377 S. Suncrest Drive. The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on June 9, 2026 at 7:00 p.m.  The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall.

notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing: Executive Municipal Officer Compensation
notices.agenda_text:
Posted on May 21, 2026, on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: Executive Municipal Officer Compensation

Notice is hereby given that the Draper City Council will hold a public hearing to consider and receive public comment regarding a proposed ordinance amending the compensation of the City's executive municipal officers in connection with the Fiscal Year 2026-27 Tentative Budget. 

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on June 2, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 
All interested persons are invited to attend and be heard.

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact John Vuyk at (801) 576-6318 or john.vuyk@draperutah.gov

Dated this 21st Day of May, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: Fiscal Year 2026-27 Tentative Budget

Notice is hereby given that the Draper City Council has adopted a Tentative Budget for Fiscal Year 2026-27 and will hold a public hearing to receive public comment regarding the proposed budget.

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on June 2, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 

The Tentative Budget is available for public inspection during regular business hours at the Office of the City Recorder located at Draper City Hall and may also be viewed on the City's website; www.draperutah.gov. 

All interested persons are invited to attend and be heard.

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact John Vuyk at (801) 576-6318 or john.vuyk@draperutah.gov

Dated this 21st Day of May, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder
